text_block_list.text:
And that's all she wrote for the Arima
Kinen! Our
all-star lineup today has
given us a race that we
won't soon
forget!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
We're witnessing the Golden Generation
being
supplanted by this year's
newcomers, led by T.M.
Opera O! What
a spectacular event!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! As far as opening acts for a

generational clash go, I suppose this will
do.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Spe and Grass... I have observed very
well the
footprints of your history with
every step you've
taken.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The time is nigh. I, the Overlord, will
carry on in
your stead.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
In the next year, this competition of ours
will be
settled once and for all.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Without question—I humbly accept your

challenge.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Really... Opera O, you're so much
stronger than I
thought!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And this is just the Classics! Come next
year, I
can't even imagine what's gonna
happen!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Heh. It'll be beyond your wildest
dreams. I can tell
you that much.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The path of an overlord is never-ending,
and I'm
on a journey to become the
Centurial Overlord,
ruler of all
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Haaaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ha—gahagh! Cough! Cough!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh no! It appears Т.М. Опера О has
begun to
choke!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: What?! Why is there still commentary?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The star of today's intense competition
both
inspires the crowd and brings them
to laughter.
Finally, we make our leave
from the course.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With that, my classic year has
concluded. I
appreciate your diligent
work, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But thus closes this act of the heroic tale
of the
young Prince Т.М. Опера О.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A new one is to begin in the next year
when I will
be a senior.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It shall be an epic, detailing my clash
with the
older generation.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
No longer will I seek their counsel
through bouts.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
You never planned to ask for their help in the
first place.

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! Excellent point!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I am the Overlord. I was born to have this role!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
If I were to ask for anything, it would be
the
money in your wallet. Hah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I know that was a joke, but I can't seem
to laugh
along.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer. In order to bring about the

resplendent future in which I rule over
the next
generation...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What race would you consider best?
Give me the
name of one worthy of the
Overlord.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A senior year race in spring comes to
mind. In
fact, the choice is obvious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How about the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho! Hark, the beautiful sound I yearned to hear—the king of all races!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It boasts notoriety and prestige! A
majestic
3200-meter parade with the
greatest racer at the
helm!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A fitting rite of passage for this new
ruler, to be
sure!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It's set. Deciding on a goal for next year
was a
breeze.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's settled. Our march toward victory
begins at
next year's spring Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
